title: Verifier-Grounded Agentic RL for Provably Correct Code
abstract: arXiv:2610.19298v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning for code usually rewards passing tests, which a model can do while remaining wrong on the inputs the tests do not cover. A program verifier instead decides whether a program satisfies a formal specification for all inputs. Language models are almost always paired with verifiers at inference time only, and turning a verifier into a reward raises two difficulties. It reports only acceptance or rejection, which gives no gradient when every attempt fails, and a policy can cheat it, most simply by telling it to assume what the proof was supposed to establish. We build an agentic environment and reward that address both. The reward reads the verifier's diagnostics rather than its verdict, scoring a candidate by the weighted fraction of proof obligations it discharges, extended with hidden probes from a reference proof's annotations. translated_title: 基于验证器的智能体强化学习实现可证明正确的代码
translated_abstract: 面向代码的强化学习通常以通过测试作为奖励，但模型即使通过了测试，在测试未覆盖的输入上仍可能是错误的。程序验证器则可以判定一个程序是否在所有输入上都满足形式化规范。语言模型几乎总是只在推理阶段与验证器配对使用，而将验证器转化为奖励信号面临两大困难：其一，验证器只报告接受或拒绝，当所有尝试都失败时无法提供梯度信号；其二，策略可以欺骗验证器，最简单的方式就是让验证器直接假设本应被证明的内容。我们构建了一个智能体环境和奖励机制来同时解决这两个问题。该奖励读取验证器的诊断信息而非其判定结果，通过候选方案所完成的证明义务的加权比例进行评分，并利用参考证明注释中的隐藏探针进行扩展。完整性审计的优先级高于验证器，会拒绝任何篡改规范的候选方案。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种读取验证器诊断信息（而非简单的接受/拒绝判定）的智能体强化学习奖励机制，结合加权证明义务完成度评分、参考证明隐藏探针以及防止篡改规范的完整性审计，解决了验证器奖励稀疏和策略作弊两大难题，从而训练出可证明正确的代码。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes an agentic RL reward that reads the verifier's diagnostics rather than its verdict, scoring candidates by the weighted fraction of discharged proof obligations with hidden probes from a reference proof and an integrity audit to prevent spec tampering, overcoming sparse rewards and reward hacking to train provably correct code generation.
